realReviews.author: Audrey Wilson
realReviews.text: I’ve searched for someone to fix my drywall and FINALLY it’s done. The toilet ran over upstairs, and the water restoration guy cut a hole in my ceiling to dry it out. After almost two long years of trying to find someone to fix it, several repair specialist came by to give estimates. Some never showed back up to do the work and some prices were so unreasonable. One phone call to Nick’s repair, not only was he was here to give an estimate, but jumped on the project almost immediately. His prices were very reasonable and as you can see in the photos, his work was immeasurable. I cannot even tell a hole was in the ceiling! There was hardly any clean up afterwards. I have a rental property and I’m hiring this company for all of my needs. Thanks Mr. Nick. You have a very satisfied customer!

realReviews.author: Jennifer Jacobsen
realReviews.text: Nick and his crew made our remodel dream come true. We imagined it and they were able to complete it just as we were thinking. They gave us great ideas to enhance our plans. They worked through all the "hickups" do to structure issues professionally. His crew was able to complete our outside vinyl siding and interior remodel as we invisioned It was an honor to work with them. His sub contractor electrician Kevin Grahamm was also fantastic. Thank You Nick and crew we are so happy with your work.

realReviews.author: Chiquita Pratt
realReviews.text: Based on Google Reviews, my husband and I hired Nick to repaint our front door and to re-stain our privacy fence. Nick was prompt, professional and his services were reasonably priced. He and his staff did AMAZING work. Nick color matched our fence stain perfectly! We highly recommend him!

finalCta.headline: Got a repair or project that's been waiting?
finalCta.body: Send a few details and photos, or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a clear estimate before any work is booked.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straight conversation about the job.

faq.a: Send the job through the form with a few photos, or call. Nick comes out to look and gives you the price and time frame before any work starts.
Florence and the surrounding Pee Dee area, including Darlington. Close by but not sure? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Do you take on small jobs?
faq.a: Yes. A ceiling patch, a new faucet or a TV mount gets the same care as a full remodel.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to set a time to look at the job.
